summary: @or-sdk/sku-builder preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 720 KB payload
details: The npm package @or-sdk/sku-builder@2.5.3 declares a preinstall script that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts and chmods the bun binary to 0755, and then invokes execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js']) on a co-located 720 KB Bun-compiled bundle. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated as a rotated-string-array VM (Bun @bun-cjs header, shift-based decoder function, large hex decoding table) and its content is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose (a TypeScript SKU-string builder client). setup.mjs itself uses obfuscator.io-style identifiers. Because the payload is executed via a downloaded alternate runtime, Node-based scanners and lifecycle hooks do not observe its behavior. Installing this package causes arbitrary, opaque code to run on the installer's host at npm install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
